title: Defend: fips_aggregate collects gate callbacks under lock, calls them after unlock
description: crypto2dev_registry.c:crypto2dev_fips_aggregate — FIPS gate callbacks are snapshot (with try_module_get) under the read_lock into a stack array, then called after read_unlock. A reviewer might suggest 'just call fips_gate() inside the read_lock to keep the code simpler'. This is wrong on PREEMPT_RT kernels: fips_gate() calls wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips(), which on degraded state calls pr_err_ratelimited(), which acquires a ratelimit spinlock. Acquiring a spinlock while holding provider_lock (also a spinlock via DEFINE_RWLOCK) creates a lock ordering dependency that is invisible to lockdep until it deadlocks in production. The snapshot-then-call pattern is the correct fix. The CRYPTO2DEV_MAX_FIPS_GATES=16 ceiling prevents unbounded stack use during the gate snapshot loop.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Rationale comments present in source.
